HB 300 Subsonic.info: Uses subsonic .300 BLK ammo. Quieter firing sound with the ability to stay completely off the radar when equipped with a suppressor and better ranged and headshot/torso damage at the cost of low bullet speed and range!

MP7 DM31.info:
An copped-plated steel armor-piercing round for the X46.
Provides excellent penetrative capabilities, but lacks overall damage.

MP7 5.7x28.info:
A 5.7x28mm conversion for the X46 based off of a civilian X46 clone.
Provides improved damage from the larger round at the cost of increased recoil and a limited magazine size.

SCAR-H 10rd.info: A smaller 10rd magazine for the MK17 SOCOM, ammo conservation will be harder in exchange for better reload time and some weight improvements.

RPK-16 60rd.info:
Loads your RPK-16 with a 60rd magazine, eliminating a lot of reload time and weight!
Larger ammo reserve pool, slightly increased handling and mobility speeds but also slightly increased recoil from the reduced weight.

Drum Magazine.info: Expands magazine capacity to hold many more rounds. This heavy magazine greatly reduces spare rounds carried, slows reload and handling speed, and slows your walkspeed, but at least you'll feel like a mobster.

Beta C Drum Mag.info:
A large 100 round Beta-C drum magazine!
Allows you to fire for a long time at the cost of walk walkspeed, your aim, sprint and equip transition speeds and increases reload time significantly!

HK Reduced Mag.info: A smaller magazine that only holds 10 rounds! But improves reload speed and lowers the overall weight of your gun significantly!

A3M2 223 BTHP.info:
Chambers your UAR A3M2 in .223 Rem BTHP, a hollow point cartridge used for high-precision sport shooting.
Comes with a 10-round magazine offering more mobility, handling and a faster reload while having great damage towards headshots but body damage becomes poor at range.

Ballista 338 Norma.info:
Loads your BALLISTA with .338 Norma Magnum.
This cartridge was developed to surpass the performance of .338 Lapua Magnum. Having a shorter cartridge length.
While it does not travel as fast and torso kill as far, it focuses on improving your firing speed!

Thunder Squeezebore.info: Swaps out your THUNDER's ammunition with squeezebore rounds, giving it multiple projectiles at the cost of accuracy and damage potential at range.

MP7 B2F.info:
A two-part fragmenting bullet designed for the X46, designed to improve damage against soft targets.
Minor spread and deals significantly higher damage if both bullets hit but lower bullet speed and penetration.

Ballista 300 Win Mag.info:
Converts your Ballista to fire .300 Winchester Magnum!
A fast bottlenecked magnum rifle cartridge with great close range damage potentional and high muzzle velocity, but shortens the torso kill range and slows down your cycling rate! Magazine carries up to 10 rounds!

Reduced Magazine.info: Reduced magazine capacity to increase mobility and handling speed.

Ballista 308 Win.info:
Converts your Ballista to fire .308 Winchester!
Faster cycling and an above average magazine capacity of 15 rounds with this lower caliber round but lowers damage and penetration!

Bolo Round.info:
Changes your shot load to a bolo.
Two large lead pellets joined together by a metal cable with incredible penetration potentional designed to rip through bodies.
High damage at range with very low spread but lacks in damage up close!

AK-12M 45rd.info: Loads your AK-12M with a 45rd magazine, increasing magazine capacity at the cost of handling and mobility! Slightly reduced overall ammo storage, but the extra weight reduces some recoil.

5.56x45 Shellshock (MK12).info: An extremely high-pressure 5.56x45mm cartridge made from a nickel alloy, designed to provide nearly 30% additional velocity to the cartridge and improve long-range ballistics. Slightly higher recoil, but better headshot performance.

SCAR SC 5.56.info:
Converts your MK16 SOCOM SC to fire 5.56x45mm NATO!
Lower close up damage, but better ranged damage, bullet speed, hipfire control and much lower recoil!

KS HARPOON.info:
Muzzle load a harpoon into your KS-23M.
 Ignoring the lack of the rope typically attached, this uses an overpressured blank shell to propel the harpoon way over yonder!

IA2 SMG Reduced Mag.info: A smaller magazine that only holds 17 rounds! But improves reload speed and lowers the overall weight of your gun significantly!

IA2 SMG 40 S&W.info:
Converts your IA2 SMG to fire .40 S&W. Increased damage up close while also increasing penetration and suppression but worse ranged performance and slightly higher recoil!
Smaller magazine capacity but lowers overall gun weight.

30rd STANAG.info: Load your rifle with a shorter 30rd STANAG magazine. Less rounds carried with greater mobility. Slightly more recoil as a result of losing weight on the weapon.

AK-19 6.02mm Mag.info:
Converts your AK-19 to fire 6.02x41mm - a highly experimental round designed in response to the Grand Federation NGSW program and 6.8x51mm ammo.
Intended as a universal replacement for 5.45x39 and 7.62x39, the AK-22 represents a hypothetical universal AK rifle. Very little else is known about the program, and it was likely shelved due to logistical costs.
Improves damage performance and penetration at the cost of recoil control.

SA58 20rd Magazine.info: A smaller 20rd magazine for the SA58 OSW, acts like a typical battle rifle now but should be on the lighter side compared to the FAL 50.00!
